description: The quieter root chrome Frame: masthead band (lede + bay), stage, and footer — but the progress rail is suppressed. Reached by dropping the rail with the `no-progress` chrome control (per-slide, or deck-wide via `class: no-progress`). For a less busy deck (design/forms.md §9). (The old `form: minimal` toggle that stamped this was retired 2026-07-03.)
